name: Grizzled Skarboy
text: Ranged attacks allocated to the bearer deal only half their printed Damage, rounded up.

effect.name: Grizzled Skarboy

name: Tellyporta
text: At Declare Battle Formations, pick one friendly BOYZ unit. The bearer and that unit both gain the Deep Strike ability; if used, they must arrive from Reserves in the same turn and be set up within 3 inches of each other.

effect.name: Tellyporta
effect.text: The bearer and the chosen BOYZ unit both gain Deep Strike and must arrive from Reserves together, set up within 3 inches of each other.
